scope: Numerical/editorial review of static source prose/table. Unavailable editorial.json/read-origin paragraphs and rendered layout are not reviewed here.

required_changes.quote: surviving sites are strongly enriched near expressed exons
required_changes.issue: The frozen scope and GENCODE annotation establish proximity to annotated exons; this analysis does not independently assign expression to a particular exon/gene at potentially homologous loci.
required_changes.replacement: surviving sites are strongly enriched near annotated exons

required_changes.quote: No baseline position switches to ≥98% of the opposite REF/ALT allele.
required_changes.issue: The zero count applies to the 2873 baseline DNA-dominant sites. Mixed-DNA RNA-monoallelic cases exist and are separately reported. The preceding context implies this but explicit scope avoids a broader negative.
required_changes.replacement: Among those 2,873 baseline DNA-dominant positions, none switches to ≥98% of the opposite REF/ALT allele.

optional_precision.quote: No finite depth cap was used (-d 0).
optional_precision.replacement: The explicit depth limit was disabled (-d 0), which samtools treats as effectively unlimited.
optional_precision.reason: Avoids implying mathematically infinite capacity; installed synthetic qualification establishes behavior at tested depth.

other_assessments.identity_or_contamination_overclaim: None found; limitations and absence of calibrated probability are explicit.
other_assessments.UMI_or_independent_molecule_overclaim: None found; query-name units not unique molecules stated.
other_assessments.independent_alignment_overclaim: None found; original-alignments dependence and not-evaluable newer alignment correctly stated.
other_assessments.exon_vs_CDS: Protein-coding gene exons plus100bp is faithful to source selection. These are UTR-inclusive exons, not necessarily coding CDS; no current sentence asserts CDS membership.
other_assessments.clean_filter: Correctly describes a separate sensitivity; correctly preserves APOD/EXOC3 reduced-depth discrepancies.
other_assessments.read_context: Pending separate review; no opinion on not-yet-inserted origin_paragraphs.
